Subject: Eval kickoff: gating information we need

Hi Vanessa / Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is aligned to run a two-week evaluation focused on inference latency and cost at scale. Before we flip on the MAP tasks I need to confirm a few items from your side so our security and infra teams can schedule the peering window: 

- Org invite / initial API key with scoped read-only test credentials (we'll only use staging models)
- Static egress IP ranges to add to our IP allowlist (we have strict outbound rules)
- VPC peering model: do you support AWS-to-AWS cross-account peering or should we use Transit Gateway?
- Sample network diagram and any required endpoint DNS names

Goal: have the environment live and smoke-tested by 2027-04-27 so we can run the evaluation during the week of 04/28.

Can you confirm owners and expected lead times? Attaching our internal network template for reference (not attached here).

Appreciate it —
Alex
Alex Porter

alex.porter@cardinalhealth.ai

Alex — thanks, great to have Cardinal Health AI moving forward. Below is a concise MAP-focused activation checklist and owners; I attached a draft MAP workbook (rdw-map-draft-v1.xlsx) and our network diagram stub (cardinal_network_diagram.pdf).

Activation checklist (high priority)
- Org invite + MAP access: I will invite your evaluation account to our org and create a scoped API key (expires in 30d) — owner: vanessa_ortiz — ETA: 1 business day
- IP allowlist (ingress): provide your intended CIDR / egress rules; we will whitelist on our edge load balancers — owner: karthik_iyer — ETA: 2 business days after ranges provided
- VPC peering: markus_klein to coordinate peering; we support cross-account peering and TGW approaches. Need account IDs and desired AZs — owner: markus_klein — ETA: peering window scheduling within 3 business days
- Test endpoints & creds: scoped token + sample curl commands included in MAP workbook — owner: vanessa_ortiz — ETA: with API key
- Security docs: SOC 2 summary & data handling notes (sent under separate cover) — owner: rishi_malhotra (security) — ETA: same day

Critical dates
- MAP signoff (this email thread + MAP workbook): by 2027-04-22
- Environment activation complete (smoke test pass): by 2027-04-27
- Eval run window: 2027-04-28 to 2027-05-05

Next steps for you: send the AWS account ID(s), and the CIDR ranges you want us to allow. If you have a procurement timeline that would block peering we should capture that now.

I'll set a 30-minute technical hang to align peering and test plan — propose Wed 2027-04-21 10:00 PT; please confirm.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

- AWS account ID(s) (production/staging if separate)
- CIDR block(s) you will accept on your side for the peering route propagation

From: Lisa Burns <lisa.burns@cardinalhealth.ai>

Thanks — procurement here. Quick procurement/contract constraints that will affect the MAP schedule:

- We need a basic SOW and data handling addendum before any private peering is scheduled (legal requirement)
- Vendor onboarding (PO setup) commonly takes up to 7 business days for enterprise purchasing
- If peering requires any formal network assessment we will need 3rd-party sign-off (security)

To keep the eval window we discussed, can Redwood provide:
1) a minimal SOW (one page) that confirms the trial is time-limited and scoped to staging data;
2) the SOC 2 summary and the redwood-map one-page security note; and
3) confirmation that credentials issued are short-lived/test-scoped and not production tokens.

If you can get these three items to procurement@cardinalhealth.ai by EOD Mon 04/26 we will try to accelerate the onboarding. Otherwise we may need to push the peering until vendor onboarding completes.

Regards,
Lisa Burns
Senior Procurement Analyst, Cardinal Health AI
procurement@cardinalhealth.ai
